mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id AS orderId, sku_id AS skuId, item_name AS itemName, quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, amount, item_type AS itemType FROM t_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order_item (order_id, sku_id, item_name, quantity, unit_price, amount, item_type, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{skuId}, #{itemName}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{amount}, #{itemType}, NOW(), NOW())
